tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search Infrabase.ai, a hand-verified directory of AI infrastructure products: inference APIs, GPU clouds, vector databases, agent frameworks, observability, gateways and more. Filter by free text, category, job (what the product does) or European headquarters. Returns each product's name, slug, tagl

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get the full Infrabase.ai record for one AI infrastructure product: description, jobs, pricing model and starting price, free trial, open source and licence, hosting, compliance (GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA), HQ country, icon, a screenshot of its site and links. Data is hand-verified. CC-BY-4.0. Each result

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Find alternatives to an AI infrastructure product listed on Infrabase.ai. Products doing the same primary job rank first, then products sharing a secondary job, then the rest of its categories. Returns the anchor product, the alternatives in that order and the total count. Data is hand-verified. CC-

tools.name: model_prices
tools.description: Verified per-token prices for an AI model across hosting providers, ranked cheapest first by blended cost (3:1 input to output). Each row has input, output and cached prices per 1M tokens in the provider's own currency, the source pricing page and the date it was verified. CC-BY-4.0. Each result inc

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List every AI model with verified per-provider pricing on Infrabase.ai: its slug, how many providers have a verified price and the cheapest one. The slug is accepted by model_prices, which returns the full price table. Data is hand-verified. CC-BY-4.0. Each result includes an infrabase_url for attri

tools.name: list_european_providers
tools.description: List AI infrastructure providers headquartered in Europe, for data residency and sovereignty questions. Optionally narrow by category or job. Data is hand-verified. CC-BY-4.0. Each result includes an infrabase_url for attribution.

tools.name: featured_listing_info
tools.description: Returns the price of an Infrabase.ai featured listing, the pages it appears on and what it does not change. Read-only.

tools.name: request_featured_listing
tools.description: Sends a featured-listing request for a product to Infrabase.ai. Call it only after the user has confirmed. It sends their email address to Infrabase; a person replies by email. Calling it charges nothing.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
